newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids mostly higher.

text.p: Dark northern spring and white wheat bids were mostly higher on Tuesday, supported by news that Pakistan bought U.S. wheat, several dealers said.
There were a few cars in today and some elevator selling, but other than that it was fairly quiet, a Minneapolis dealer said.
U.S. wheat futures markets were buoyed after Pakistan opted to buy 450,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat over the weekend.
"It's good. It did not do much for the price, but at shipment time that's when we will see some price support there" as the pipeline is refilled, an Oregon merchandiser said.
The sale will help "down the road," another dealer said. One Washington state merchandiser noted some movement of white wheat.
